name: Homepage
description: A fast start page for your homelab, with service widgets and bookmarks.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Your dashboard settings: services.yaml, bookmarks.yaml, widgets.yaml, settings.yaml and the rest. Starter files are made on first start. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Homepage web page, published on host as 6733

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like 192.168.1.20:6733. This is the address you type in the browser, without http://. Add more, comma separated, like a domain you use.
